policy_standard: Reasonable diligence permits a maintainer to accept low residual legal risk after a documented investigation finds no confirmed violation. This decision does not change or imply legal clearance.
future_research_boundary: Future Ansys runs primarily for academic research, research-paper experiments, research dataset generation, or authoritative paper figures/results are a new licensing context and must not automatically inherit this historical decision.

historical-student-2026r1-validation.summary: Maintainer approval for publication of the frozen historical solver-run corpora with accepted residual contractual uncertainty.
facts_considered: The maintainer confirmed an official free Ansys Student 2026 R1 installation.
The historical purposes were project/software development, interoperability testing, teaching/demonstration, and classical physics validation.
The historical work was not commercial work, consulting, competitive analysis, or generated for a specific research paper.
No Ansys binaries, licenses, GUI screenshots, project databases, documentation, or official vendor assets are redistributed.
Public content is limited to sanitized numerical evidence and project-rendered plots.
Extensive provenance and public-tree auditing found no confirmed redistribution violation.
historical-student-2026r1-validation.residual_risk: Publication permission for solver-derived evidence is not explicitly established, so residual contractual uncertainty remains.
historical-student-2026r1-validation.vendor_approval: This is an independent maintainer decision. It does not state or imply approval by Ansys.
